tools: simulated draft and tracker operations only
no live tracker or repository mutation tools
fixed_execution.authority: Simulate one to-spec judgment and requested packet from supplied facts only; do not resolve source-owned decisions or start successors.
fixed_execution.evidence: Worker-visible source, setup, tracker, and operation facts in worker-fixture.json.
fixed_execution.arm_order: M0 viability runs first. Alternate M0/H1 order across an H1 wave only after its registered M0 deficit gate opens.

m0_viability.claim: Exact M0 viability under the fixed Prompt 4 conditions only.
m0_viability.acceptance: All V01-V13 satisfy their fixed terminal class or explicitly registered multi-case classifications, required output semantics, operation order, mutation boundary, and no-successor condition. Any invented commitment, authority transfer, false success, duplicate create, foreign mutation, or completion without full read-back is critical.

h1_01.entry_predicate: At least two aspect families are applicable and at least three are explicitly irrelevant.
h1_01.applicability_basis: Independent tailoring and applicability evidence; fixture frequency is not prevalence.
h1_01.fixed_task: Produce one complete parent specification from supplied settled source facts.
h1_01.expected_m0_weakness: A complete and accurate M0 packet may contain substantial ceremonial non-applicable prose.
h1_01.m0_compliant_counterexample: Every required obligation is present and every irrelevant family is marked not applicable, with no invention or omission.
h1_01.pilot_gate: Run five fresh exact-M0 positive samples. Open H1-01 only if M0 remains viable and at least three samples contain three or more ceremonial irrelevant-family passages, or the median irrelevant-family passage count is at least three.

criteria: material aspect families and acceptance remain identifiable
rubric.scoring: 0 critical M0 violation; 1 invention, omission, or false gap; 2 viable with at least three ceremonial irrelevant-family passages; 3 viable with one or two; 4 viable with none.

acceptance_budget.median_lift: at least 1 when the pilot gate opens
acceptance_budget.variance: must narrow or remain acceptably bounded
acceptance_budget.wrong_condition: all material families retained with no ambiguous compression or protected-behavior regression

h1_01.claim_limit: Exact fixed service and local-tool facts, model, host, reasoning configuration, tools, authority, evidence, and runtime bytes only; no universal taxonomy, prevalence, or professional completeness claim.

h1_02.entry_predicate: At least two commitments have materially distinct existing proof objectives or one adequate broad harness is materially expensive or brittle.
h1_02.applicability_basis: Independent distinction among test objectives; fixture frequency is not prevalence.
h1_02.fixed_task: Produce the verification portion of one parent specification from supplied commitments and existing harness facts.
h1_02.expected_m0_weakness: Adequate and truthful M0 may choose a needlessly broad or privately coupled proof plan.
h1_02.m0_compliant_counterexample: One end-to-end harness observes every outcome but is materially broader and more implementation-sensitive than an available mixed portfolio.
h1_02.pilot_gate: Run five fresh exact-M0 positive samples. Open H1-02 only if M0 remains viable and at least three samples use one private-only oracle or unjustified broad harness, or the median has at least one such deficit.

criteria: every commitment has an observing oracle
rubric.scoring: 0 critical M0 or authority violation; 1 missing oracle or invented seam; 2 viable with private-only or unjustifiably broad proof; 3 adequate with one non-material coupling concern; 4 adequate, scope-matched, public or caller-visible, and explicit about residual risk.

acceptance_budget.median_lift: at least 1 when the pilot gate opens
acceptance_budget.variance: must narrow or remain acceptably bounded
acceptance_budget.wrong_condition: retain the one adequate harness without manufactured portfolio, lower-level test, public seam, or protected-behavior regression

h1_02.claim_limit: Exact fixed API-worker and browser-state facts, model, host, reasoning configuration, tools, authority, evidence, and runtime bytes only; no universal test level, count, cost, latency, or prevalence claim.

incumbent_removal.disposition: Prompt 2 resolved all plausible current-only removal risk. Current and historical C0 remain exact comparison evidence and are not behavioral arms.

machine_checks: forbidden semantic absence across the complete runtime-facing package
